mapper.sql: fp.financial_pattern_id, fp.user_id, fp.shortcut_number, fp.pattern_type, fp.title, fp.description, fp.linked_bank_account_id, ba.bank_code, ba.bank_name, ba.account_number, ba.account_alias, rp.registered_person_id, rp.name AS registered_person_name, rp.relationship
mapper.select: SELECT FROM financial_patterns fp LEFT JOIN bank_accounts ba ON ba.bank_account_id = fp.linked_bank_account_id LEFT JOIN registered_persons rp ON rp.registered_person_id = ba.registered_person_id WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId} AND fp.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY fp.shortcut_number

SELECT FROM financial_patterns fp LEFT JOIN bank_accounts ba ON ba.bank_account_id = fp.linked_bank_account_id LEFT JOIN registered_persons rp ON rp.registered_person_id = ba.registered_person_id WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId} AND fp.financial_pattern_id = #{patternId} AND fp.is_active = TRUE

SELECT pattern_step_id, financial_pattern_id, step_order, step_code, step_name, instruction_text, screen_code, target_element_id, voice_file_path, voice_content_type FROM pattern_steps WHERE financial_pattern_id = #{patternId} AND step_code != 'TRANSFER_COMPLETE' ORDER BY step_order
SELECT financial_pattern_id FROM financial_patterns WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY financial_pattern_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND bank_account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT bank_account_id FROM bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND registered_person_id IS NULL ORDER BY is_primary DESC, bank_account_id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_patterns SET is_active = FALSE, shortcut_number = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT usage_log_agreed FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT pe.status FROM pattern_executions pe JOIN financial_patterns fp ON fp.financial_pattern_id = pe.financial_pattern_id WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId} AND pe.pattern_execution_id = #{executionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT visit_number + 1 FROM step_execution_logs WHERE pattern_execution_id = #{executionId} AND pattern_step_id = #{stepId} ORDER BY visit_number DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE step_execution_logs SET retry_count = GREATEST(retry_count, #{retryCount}), back_count = GREATEST(back_count, #{backCount}), wrong_touch_count = GREATEST(wrong_touch_count, #{wrongTouchCount}), route_deviation = route_deviation OR #{routeDeviation}, completed = #{completed}, ended_at = #{endedAt} WHERE step_execution_log_id = #{visitId} AND ended_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT pe.ended_at FROM pattern_executions pe JOIN financial_patterns fp ON fp.financial_pattern_id = pe.financial_pattern_id WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId} AND pe.pattern_execution_id = #{executionId}
